newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Agouron estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Agouron estimates raised.

text.p: Alex. Brown said it raised its earnings estimates and price target and reiterated a strong buy on shares of Agouron Pharmaceuticals Inc, based on firm trends for the company's HIV protease inhibitor Viracept.

-- Alex. Brown analysts Kevin Tang and Patrick Cheng said in a research note they raised their fourth quarter earnings estimate to a loss of $0.19 per share versus a previous estimated loss of $0.37 per share. They raised fiscal 1998 earnings estimates to $0.50 per share from $0.13 per share.
-- The firm said it was raising its 12-month price target on Agouron to $118 per share from $109 per share.
-- "We are raising our estimates based on extremely strong prescription and reorder trends pertaining to Viracept, Agouron's HIV protease inhibitor," they said.

-- "IMS America shows Viracept representing 10 percent of total HIV protease inhibitor prescriptions for the month of April, the first full month of Viracept availability," they said. "Moreover, over the past month, total prescriptions of Viracept have grown 36 percent."
-- Agouron shares were trading up 1-13/16 at 85-3/8.
